shared_expression_dependencies.rationale: Scan is explicitly digitization of a record under an existing process. Including document capture clarifies this use while archive remains separately governed.
Count determines number, sort groups supplies, weigh determines heaviness and measure covers ingredient quantities. Preserve measure beyond dimensions.
Weigh, sort, pack and label have distinct preparation meanings and are assigned through a question about roles. No production method is taught.
Fold and hang describe laundry actions in a question about the person's preference. Both selected physical senses fit; the sentence grants no care procedure approval.
Fold, hang and lift retain their physical meanings. The wording first confirms responsibilities and prescribes no lifting technique.
Carry concerns supported movement of equipment and is asked about as an assigned role. It is not merely raising the equipment.
Lift is a physical raising action and is explicitly deferred until professional guidance and role clarification. Keep the wording exact.
Lift, load, unload, unpack and label all fit goods handling. The sentence asks for the approved method, and the broader unpack definition remains compatible.
Lift concerns a person and is framed as a question about roles under an existing care plan. Retain its person-or-object definition and context-only status.
Load and lift are verbs within a role-clarification question and an existing plan. Preserve the non-procedural meaning.
Count concerns page quantity and sort concerns record grouping. These remain distinct actions within the filing request.
Sort concerns grouping separated goods. It does not duplicate the distinct consolidate and deconsolidate focuses.

Replenish restores supplies and sort groups them. Empty and refill have different objects; no exclusive synonym distinction is claimed.

Count concerns items in a shipment and is part of a request to identify the responsible worker. The numerical sense is correct.
Count determines how many objects and compare examines results. The other investigative verbs are outside this bounded review.

Measure takes an item and a proposed result record. The general quantitative definition remains appropriate.
Measure concerns specified dimensions and compare concerns the results. This is one valid narrow instance of the broader measurement definition.
Measure results is a quantitative evaluation use, so retain the broad degree-or-amount definition rather than dimensions only.
Measure is an incidental noun in agreed measure, not the selected verb focus. Do not treat the literal match as a scored route.
Measure concerns an agreed quantity in a supervised plan, preserving its broad sense without prescribing measurement or care.

Load is the verb placing goods for transport. The authorized-team context remains exact and is not a loading method.
Compare is a focused verb examining instructions. The later load is an incidental noun, not a route for load.put-goods-for-transport.v.

Recommend takes a that-clause proposing an action. The revised person, thing or action definition explicitly preserves this existing use.
Compare and recommend relate to available choices and their features. The definition allowing people or actions also retains this thing-choice use.
Demonstrate shows the product, compare examines options and recommend suggests a choice for stated needs. All selected verb senses fit.
Compare, select and recommend all concern people or evidence in a candidate review. The person-inclusive clarifications preserve the intended uses.
Compare takes reported results and covers examining differences and similarities. It does not certify the other diagnostic verbs or their sequence.
Compare concerns authored wording and its source. It fits examining correspondence without narrowing the verb to physical products.

Compare concerns assumptions before a proposal, fitting the examination sense rather than a transaction operation.
Demonstrate takes a how-clause for call controls and fits showing how an action is performed. It is not the evidence/proof sense.

Select takes a case from a queue and fits choosing an available option; broadening to people and things does not alter this use.
Select takes headings, an abstract document option; it fits the generalized choosing sense.
Select concerns choosing an order; no completed purchase or item suitability is implied.

Decline is an offer-refusal verb. Purchase is an incidental noun after into a and is not focused as the selected purchase verb.
Exchange concerns returning goods for replacement; charge asks the amount due. The reconnection clause remains outside this selected-sense review.

Reconcile concerns recorded stock differences. Explanation or correction of a discrepancy fits; no arbitrary adjustment is authorized.
Reconcile takes an amount and a receipt as records to compare. The existing meaning expressly withholds unauthorized changes, fitting the clarification.

original_consultation_records.title: GS1: What is a barcode?
